name: Ship
why: A Code Project idea, from a fresh thread to a merged pull request
ideal: A fresh thread finds the rules and templates ready, pushes in few attempts, and its pull request is live within a day.

sources.title: Creating a pull request template for your repository

steps.name: Ready
steps.rule: A fresh thread finds the shared rules, their import, the main rule, templates, CI and settings in place.

steps.name: Check
steps.rule: The setup check reads its files within a second, so running it costs nothing.

steps.name: Build
steps.rule: A thread pushes after each step, and each push starts checks, so few pushes means few waits.

steps.name: Pull request
steps.rule: The template is a short layout to fill in, since every thread reads it on every pull request.

steps.name: Guard
steps.rule: A change to a guard or workflow stays, since an undone one means the first version did not work.

steps.name: Live
steps.rule: A session's change is live within a day, by the typical time of each step added up.
